items.title: Anthony Black is shooting 40% from beyond the arc this year. However, he's shooting 33.3% from the corners.
items.author: Bobby Krivitsky
items.body_excerpt:
Anthony Black is shooting 40% from beyond the arc this year. However, he's shooting 33.3% from the corners.

The Celtics seem to have no problem with him getting shots from there. He has taken three 3s already, tied for the most in the game.

They've all been from the corner. Black is 1/3 to start.
